Thankfully, the Soundcore Space 2 are currently on sale at Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart […]

item.title: Elon Musk’s dangerous grip on outer space
item.description: Last week, Starshield - the version of SpaceX's Starlink used by the Ukrainian military - was throttled to block terminals traveling above certain speeds from accessing the service. The Ukrainian army's interceptors, which counter Russian drones carrying bombs, suddenly stopped working at high speeds, making it easier for Russia to attack the country's energy infrastructure […]...

item.title: Bluetooth backlash and nostalgia helped Bose launch wired headphones that keep selling out
item.description: The audio company’s latest wired headphones take retro-cool and incorporate now-standard features. They’re already a big seller. Last fall, Raza Haider, president of premium consumer audio at Bose, noticed something peculiar when dropping his daughter off at college: more students were wearing wired headphones than he’d seen in recent years. “Even [my daughter] made a comment like, ‘this is nuts. When I was in high school, we would have made fun of kids who had wired headphones, and now it feels like all the cool kids have them,’” Haider says. ...

item.title: First Pillsbury and Trader Joe’s. Now another food brand is recalling products over glass concerns
item.description: Natural Grocers is the latest retailer to recall a food product over possible glass contamination, following similar recalls involving Pillsbury and Trader Joe’s products earlier this year. Nobody wants a side of broken glass with their dinner. Unfortunately, that’s the concern behind the latest food recall, and it’s not the first time this year shoppers have been warned about glass potentially lurking in their food....

item.title: Test de l’Oppo Find X10 : un excellent photophone haut de gamme, malgré quelques compromis
item.description: Oppo renouvelle son haut de gamme avec le Find X10. Équipé d'une batterie colossale de 7150 mAh, d'une puce Dimensity 9600M et de deux capteurs de 200 mégapixels, ce modèle compact entend rivaliser avec l'élite du marché.

item.title: What AI leaves out of the answer still counts
item.description: AI companies are starting to pay for content that shows up in answers. The case for also paying for the library behind them is stronger than it looks. There’s a contradiction emerging in how publishers get paid when AI uses their content. The licensing deals that OpenAI, Meta, Amazon, and others have been signing these past few years appear to be slowing down, at least for the publishers still waiting on one....
